applies_why: This judge text resolves a pressed Luke 2:48-49 objection by immediate verse-level qualification rather than by weighing the parties' chains by footing.
quote: Mary's phrase "thy father" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to "my Father's business."
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: Phrase: 'never verse by verse.' Reading 1: it bars any verse-level qualification in a chain-vs-chain collision. Reading 2: it bars only the retired stating-verse test (requiring an explicit contrary statement) and allows immediate-context qualification. I weighed the judge's immediate-qualification reason under both.
why: The judge text resolves the pressed Luke 2:48-49 objection by immediate verse-level qualification, not by weighing chain against chain by footing, which K-C forbids.
